entries.title: Jeremiah 14:1
segments: ¶The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth. {the dearth: Heb. the words of the dearths, or, restraints}

words.text: . {the dearth: Heb. the words of the dearths, or, restraints}

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:2
segments: Judah mourneth, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:3
segments: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, [and] found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:4
segments: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:5
segments: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook [it], because there was no grass.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:6
segments: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because [there was] no grass.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:7
segments: O LORD, though our iniquities testify against us, do thou [it] for thy name's sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against thee.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:8
segments: O the hope of Israel, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why shouldest thou be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man [that] turneth aside to tarry for a night?

words.text: , why shouldest thou be as a stranger

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:9
segments: Why shouldest thou be as a man astonied, as a mighty man [that] cannot save? yet thou, O LORD, [art] in the midst of us, and we are called by thy name; leave us not. {we...: Heb. thy name is called upon us}

words.text: Why shouldest thou be as a man
of us, and we are called
us not. {we...: Heb. thy name is called upon us}

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:10
segments: ¶Thus saith the LORD unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore the LORD doth not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:11
segments: Then said the LORD unto me, Pray not for this people for [their] good.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:12
segments: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:13
segments: Then said I, Ah, Lord GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, Ye shall not see the sword, neither shall ye have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place. {assured...: Heb. peace of truth}

words.text: unto them, Ye shall not see

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:14
segments: Then the LORD said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

words.text: them not, neither have I commanded

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:15
segments: Therefore thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

words.text: shall not be in this land

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:16
segments: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

words.text: ; and they shall have none to bury

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:17
segments: ¶Therefore thou shalt say this word unto them; Let mine eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:18
segments: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not. {go about...: or, make merchandise against a land, and men acknowledge it not}

words.text: , then behold them that are sick
not. {go about...: or, make merchandise against a land, and men acknowledge it not}

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:19
segments: Hast thou utterly rejected Judah? hath thy soul lothed Zion? why hast thou smitten us, and [there is] no healing for us? we looked for peace, and [there is] no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:20
segments: We acknowledge, O LORD, our wickedness, [and] the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against thee.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:21
segments: Do not abhor [us], for thy name's sake, do not disgrace the throne of thy glory: remember, break not thy covenant with us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 14:22
segments: Are there [any] among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? [art] not thou he, O LORD our God? therefore we will wait upon thee: for thou hast made all these [things].

words.text: upon thee: for thou hast made
